chapter_name: Feel the Rhythm (Ta Ka Ta Ki Ta)
learning_objective: 🎯 We will discover how music and art go hand-in-hand by drawing dancing lines and feeling the musical beats!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Just like we dance to music, our crayons can dance on paper! Zig-zag lines look like fast drum beats, and wavy lines look like a slow, sweet song.
When you hear a loud 'Ta Ka Ta Ki Ta', you can make big colorful splashes. When the music is quiet, you can draw tiny, gentle dots.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Musical Doodle Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your parents to play a fun song. Let your crayon move on the paper exactly how the music makes you feel. See what shapes you create!

quick_recap: ⭐ Lines and shapes can show rhythm and movement, just like dancing.
⭐ We can use fast, zig-zag lines for loud music and wavy lines for soft music.
⭐ Mixing art with music makes drawing even more exciting!
